ModMetaData.name: Rim-Kaisen
ModMetaData.author: JJK Mod Team
ModMetaData.description:
A Jujutsu Kaisen total conversion for RimWorld, built on the Taran Magic Framework. Sorcery runs on a full cursed-energy system: Biotech genes grant innate cursed techniques, sorcerers climb the grades from Grade 4 to Calamity, and cursed spirits manifest as Anomaly entities.

Wield cursed techniques - Limitless, Ten Shadows shikigami, Shrine, Disaster Flames, Cursed Speech, the Straw Doll Technique and more - and unleash Domain Expansions that clash for dominance. Learn Reverse Cursed Technique, swear binding vows for power at a price, and research jujutsu on its own tech tree.

Exorcise the cursed spirits born from the dead, fend off the Curse Users faction, and survive Kenjaku's scheming. Run your colony as a jujutsu sorcerer outpost.

With Ideology, choose six Jujutsu belief paths: Guardians of Humanity, the New Generation, Clan Orthodoxy, Sorcerer Supremacy, the Sovereign Self, and Cursed Evolution. Each adds distinct precepts, social attitudes and themed gatherings. Belief does not grant innate techniques.

Requires: Harmony, Taran Magic Framework, Biotech, and Anomaly (Royalty and Ideology optional).
